gloss: muscular and powerfully built; having a strong, well-developed physique

definitions.gloss: muscular and powerfully built; having a strong, well-developed physique
definitions.explanation: muscular and powerfully built; having a strong, well-developed physique

examples.japanese: {筋骨|きんこつ}たくましい{男|おとこ}だ。
{筋骨|きんこつ}たくましい{体|からだ}つきの{力士|りきし}が{土俵|どひょう}に{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: A powerfully built sumo wrestler stepped onto the ring.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}の{肉体|にくたい}{労働|ろうどう}で、{彼|かれ}は{筋骨|きんこつ}たくましい{体|からだ}になった。
examples.english: From daily physical labor, he developed a muscular physique.

notes:
A set phrase combining {筋骨|きんこつ} (muscles and bones; physical frame) with たくましい (sturdy/robust). Describes someone with a visibly strong, well-muscled body — the kind of physique associated with physical laborers, athletes, or warriors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筋骨|きんこつ}たくましい{体|からだ} — a powerfully built body
- {筋骨|きんこつ}たくましい{男性|だんせい} — a muscular man
- {筋骨|きんこつ}たくましい{腕|うで} — brawny arms

USAGE:
Typically describes men, though not exclusively. The expression has a somewhat literary or descriptive quality — it appears more in written descriptions (novels, journalism, character descriptions) than in casual conversation, where マッチョ (macho) or {筋肉質|きんにくしつ} (muscular) might be preferred.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- がっしりした — solidly built; sturdy (more casual)
- マッチョ — macho; muscular (loanword, casual)
- {筋肉質|きんにくしつ} — muscular (objective description of body type)
- たくましい — sturdy; robust (the adjective alone, broader meaning)
